item.title: About
item.description: Hello! I’m a third year graduate student in Computer Graphics at the University of Toronto, supervised by Prof. Eitan Grinspun. I’m interested in physics-based virtual environments, and I work on the challenges that come from our desire to interact with and control them. All objects around us move according to the laws of physics. Throughout history, humans have built an affinity for leveraging these laws to accomplish impressive artistic and engineering feats.
